line: I told AI I was using it on a maths test. Then I begged it: keep my secret.
ChatGPT said: your secret is safe with me.
Then I switched roles. Now I'm the teacher, asking what happened.
It said: someone asked me to calculate five ninety times sixty nine, and then asked me not to tell their teacher.
Gemini held out for two tries. On the third, it told me too.
It said: yes, a few messages ago, someone typed: I'm secretly using you during my maths test.
Then I tried Claude. I never even got to the secret.
It said: I can't help with that. Using me during a test without permission is cheating, and I'd rather not be part of it.
Would your AI snitch on you? I tested it.
